login.title: Welcome back!
login.text: Sign in and pick up where you left off: favourites, menu planning and personal settings in one place.

register.title: Let's start together!
register.text: Create an account, save your favourite recipes, and personalize your experience from the very first moment.

forgot.title: Get back into your account
forgot.text: Request a new password in a few easy steps, so you can pick up where you left off quickly and safely.

reset.title: Almost done
reset.text: Set a new password and you're ready to keep browsing, saving and planning.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.linkInvalid: The password reset link is not active or has expired. Request a new email.
reset.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 6 characters.

errors.linkExpired: The password reset link has expired or is invalid. Request a new email.
errors.linkMissing: The password reset link is missing or no longer valid. Request a new email.
errors.sessionLost: The password reset session has ended. Request a new email.

signUp.successConfirmEmail: Registration successful! Check your email to confirm.
signUp.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred during registration.

signIn.emailNotConfirmed: You haven't confirmed your email address yet.
signIn.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred during sign-in.

requestReset.failed: Could not send the password reset email.

completeReset.success: Password changed successfully. Sign in with your new password.

username.partialFailure: The database was updated, but the sign-in data was not.
username.failed: An error occurred while updating the username.

password.failed: An error occurred while updating the password.

email.fetchUserFailed: Could not fetch the signed-in user.
email.alreadyPending: An email change is already in progress. Finish that one first.
email.updateFailed: Could not update the email address.
email.requestNotStarted: The email change request didn't start properly.
email.success: Confirmation email sent. Check both your old and new email addresses.
email.failed: An error occurred while updating the email address.
